newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Korea's LTCB Kangaroo FRN set at 21 bp over.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Korea's LTCB Kangaroo FRN set at 21 bp over.

text.p: Korea Long Term Credit Bank's A$125 million, three-year floating rate note has been been priced at 21 basis points over the 90-day bank bill swap rate (BBSW), lead manager Commonwealth Bank of Australia said.
This is the first FRN to be issued in a Kangaroo structure, which is a foreign debt raising in the Australian domestic market.
The notes mature on December 17, 1999 with settlement on December 17, 1996.
The notes are offered at a discounted issue price of 99.973 which reflects a pricing of 20 basis point over BBSW, although investors will receive a coupon of 21 basis points over, CBA said.
Co-managers are Bankers Trust Australia and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
